Not a session? Delete the checklist.

**Session checklist** ([speaker guide](https://github.com/danielriosgarza/ai-school-2/blob/main/docs/speaker-guide.md))

- [ ] One topic folder under `courses/second-edition/`, shaped as the guide shows
- [ ] `npx parallax check` run locally: 0 errors, the ids it wrote committed
- [ ] Every file under 25 MiB; at most 100 data files per notebook folder
- [ ] No e-mail addresses or other personal data in the files or the notebooks' outputs
- [ ] Each notebook executed from start to end and saved with its outputs
- [ ] Each notebook run through Run on this computer, in a new environment built from its `requirements.txt` alone
- [ ] Each `requirements.txt` (or `environment.yml`) pins every package the notebook imports with `==`
